approach: conservative appearance, constrained numeral OCR, and distinct-view agreement

calibration.method: grouped leave-capture-group-out on training scenes only
calibration.eligibility: identity is accepted only with at least the configured correct OOF candidates and zero incorrect OOF candidates
calibration.high_confidence_oof_errors: disable that candidate identity instead of clipping the global probability threshold
calibration.reported_confidence: heuristic score combining component posterior with normalized OOF distance support; not a calibrated correctness probability

number_evidence.source: white-medallion segmentation and constrained 1-15 font-template comparisons

sequence.confidence_aggregation: minimum supporting view probability; never multiplied by vote count

limitations: Video evaluation frames share one recording and are not independent camera sessions.
Font-template number evidence is expected to abstain on undersampled, tilted, or occluded digits.
This experiment does not qualify other ball sets, cameras, or lighting.
Caller must enforce object-track coherence and reject stale detections after motion, reassociation, session, or settings changes.
